name: Enomoto Yuka
source:
Zodiac: Taurus
Precise weight: 45.8 kg.

A junior of Takuma and Shin'ya, and a classmate of Naoya. She is also [url=/c115128]Mayuu[/url]'s classmate and best friend. The two girls get along well despite them having seemingly opposite personalities. Even though Yuka is mostly aloof, short-spoken and expressionless, a year ago she was a more cheerful and energetic girl. Could she really have changed so much in a year?

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20031014071144/http://www.pinkpineapple.co.jp/pinpai/xmas/character/character.html]official website[/url].]
